correctness.rationale: Verified \(\dot w=-x(2w^2-bw+1)\), the explicit primitive \(I_b\), two smooth matching half-plane arcs for the unique periodic solution and the exact axis-crossing limits. The time quadrature and beta–gamma identity agree at high precision; Laplace endpoint asymptotics derive the exact essential-exponential prefactor, and direct arctangent expansions give the crossing constants. No numerical extrapolation is substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The discriminant boundary is the precise mathematical loss-of-center threshold. The exact essential-exponential divergence and sharp prefactor for original physical time, together with finite/nonzero versus exponentially suppressed oriented crossing speeds, quantify a natural degeneration unavailable from qualitative phase portraits or monotonicity at a fixed coefficient.
